title: Integral comparison for the constructed presented projective-line datum
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring killed by N, with normalized twist transport t and arbitrary-base splittings d satisfying trace base change [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Let f:X → S be proper and i:X ≅ P¹_S over S, with N invertible on S. For every supported Ext representative κ on P¹_S ×_S P¹_S, form the explicitly constructed datum D of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data] using trace (d S).trace. Each of the two compact-support diagonal integrals of D equals inverse image along i of the corresponding ordinary projective-line supported integral, conjugated by SfP1Transport.constantComparison. No integral normalization is assumed.

source.place: Both diagonal triangle calculations and the actual inverse-projection counit.

proof.text: Expand the supported map as diagonal lift, pullback of the Ext map, and coefficient comparison. The section comparison identifies the lift after proper projection exchange. Naturality moves the Ext map through exchange and cancels the coefficient comparison with its inverse.
Compose the supported-map equation with the trace comparison. Functoriality and associativity give conjugation of the ordinary supported-map/trace composite by the constant comparison.

Evaluate the Boolean projection at false and true. The coordinate definitions become respectively the first and second SfDiagonalKernel integrals, including the shifted-line comparison in the second coordinate.

lean.statement:
theorem presentedFiniteP1Datum_integral_comparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t T hT)
    (hbc : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d)
    (S X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (κ : Ext
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A (ProjectiveLine S)))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) N A hA) 2) :
    let D := SfP1Transport.datum A N hA t f i hi hS (d S hS).trace κ
    let c := SfP1Transport.constantComparison A i
    ((SfDiagonalKernel.diagonalFirst A f).hom.app
        (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f)).map
        D.diagonalClass ≫ SfDiagonalKernel.traceFirst A D =
      c.inv ≫ (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
        (ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalSupportedMap A N hA S false κ ≫
          arbitraryBaseFiniteP1DiagonalTrace A N hA t d S hS false) ≫ c.hom) ∧
    ((TraceDiagonalDatum.idIsoDiagonalSnd (Λ := A) f).hom.app
        (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)).map
        D.diagonalClass ≫
      SfDiagonalKernel.traceSecond A D
        (CoordinateTrace.shiftedLine A (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine S N A hA) 1)
        (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t f hS).symm =
      c.inv ≫ (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
        (ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalSupportedMap A N hA S true κ ≫
          arbitraryBaseFiniteP1DiagonalTrace A N hA t d S hS true) ≫ c.hom)
